acceptance: PyPI and TestPyPI histories reviewed with no unexplained events, or findings recorded as new items
Each listed App installation and secret change confirmed as intended or revoked
description:
BenchBox releases up to 0.4.2 were published with pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish releases older than the v1.14.3 fix for the compromised eMudhra emSign CAs (GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9), and the maintainer's tools reached PyPI and GitHub through clients that trusted them. A public audit found every PyPI file reproducible from source and no unexpected publication, but it could not see owner-only records. The owner should review:

- PyPI and TestPyPI project security history for `benchbox` (uploads, deleted files, API tokens, trusted-publisher changes) from 2025-04-30 to now, especially 2026-08-28 03:14-12:22 UTC, when two v0.4.0 publish attempts failed with `invalid-publisher` and a third succeeded.
- GitHub App installations made since 2026-09 (benchbox-publication-controller, benchbox-oracle, benchbox-site-bridge, and the `claude` app, which can write contents, workflows, actions and repository hooks on all repositories) and repository secrets created or updated since 2026-07.
- Why the v0.4.0 and v0.4.2 GitHub Releases were edited shortly after their release jobs finished (asset digests are unchanged).

The organisation audit-log API is unavailable on the current plan, so this is a UI review.
